description: HEL-1316 seam fixture: the exact config the window step editor persists (the PATCH body's config) for a rolling window, plus a gappy dated input and the outputs it must produce. Read by frontend WindowConfig.seam.test.tsx (drives the real editor, asserts its PATCH body config equals `config` with an exact key set) and backend WindowRollingSeamSpec (creates the step through the real step route, analyzes it, submits a real run with an Output on the step over `input` and asserts the materialized Output rows equal `expected` (an unparseable date and a null value are included)). A key renamed on either side fails one of them.
